text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I can finally run!!
—In the Osaka Hai!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Osaka Hai is a race open only to the Senior Class.
From here on, you will engage in even fiercer battles against highly experienced upperclassmen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Several GⅠ-winning Umamusume are running today as well. Among them, Epiphaneia carries high expectations, but—"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's right!
I'm gonna win for sure!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
This is where it begins, Trainer!
Grant me destiny once more today, and then—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Epiphaneiaaaaa!!"
"Blow them all awayyyyyy!!"
"We're counting on you!" "Goooo!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Amazing, so many girls are here...!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you, everyone!
Keep your eyes on my radiance!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: "Today once again, I shall bestow destiny upon you! And grant you a blissful awakening!!"
